landing.lead: Small groups around dialogue prompts from your network. Bring together people who already share a story, but rarely meet.
landing.howLead: From opening a gathering to what Ember learns, in six steps.

create.title: You open an invitation
create.body: Choose the theme, question, and possible times. Invite everyone in the community.

register.title: Members respond
register.body: Each person shares when they're free, which language they prefer, and how they want to show up.

match.title: Ember forms the groups
match.body: It weighs availability, language, and who has already met. You review and publish.

meet.title: Everyone gets the invite
meet.body: Conversation link, local time, and calendar file. Everything ready for the day.

gather.title: People meet
gather.body: At the agreed time, they join and talk, small groups, shared question, real presence.

followup.title: Ember learns
followup.body: When the conversation ends, participants indicate they were there. Ember learns who has already met, and in upcoming gatherings brings together people who have not talked yet.

landing.hostingLead: Ember is open source. You choose who runs the day-to-day, your team or ours.

self.title: On your own
self.body: Your community installs and maintains everything with your own team. The software is free; you handle the infrastructure.

managed.title: With our help
managed.body: We can host, keep it running, and handle maintenance for you. You pay for the service, not per member or per gathering.

landing.hostingNote: Either way, your data and your members stay yours.
landing.hostingGithubLink: View code and install on GitHub
landing.notLead: Built for belonging that already exists, not for chasing an audience.
landing.manifesto: Space for presence among people who already share a story.
landing.finalLead: The demo runs in your browser with fictional characters. Browse as a community steward or as a member.
landing.demoHint: No real signup, just to see how it works.
landing.contactLead: Ember is an independent project I maintain. If your community wants to use it or you need help getting started, send me an email.
landing.contactEmailHint: Questions, setup, or partnering with your community.
landing.contactGithubHint: Open-source repo with code and instructions to get it running.
landing.contactLinkedInHint: Profile of the person behind the project.
landing.contactGithubAria: Open the Ember repository on GitHub
landing.footer: Ember, intentional gatherings for closed communities.
